logisticmatica.name: Logisticmatica
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudEna: Master toggle for the Logisticmatica material HUD.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudRen: Also draw the HUD while a screen/menu is open (e.g. over inventories). Off by default so it stays a gameplay overlay and does not cover menus.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudAli: Which screen corner the HUD is anchored to.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudOff: Horizontal offset in pixels from the aligned corner.
Vertical offset in pixels from the aligned corner.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudSca: Scale factor for the HUD text and icons.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudMax: Maximum number of item rows shown in the HUD. 0 = unlimited (show the whole list).
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudHid: Hide items that are already fully available.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudOnl: Only show items that are still missing from the build.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudSho: Show a header line with the schematic name and totals.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudBac: Draw a translucent background behind the HUD.
logisticmatica.config.hud.comment.hudSho: Draw the item icon next to each row.
logisticmatica.config.colors.comment.col: Color of the normal HUD text.
Color of the HUD header line.
Color used for items that are fully available.
Color used for the still-missing amount.
Color of the HUD background, alpha included.
logisticmatica.config.hotkeys.comment.op: Opens the Logisticmatica material list screen.
logisticmatica.config.hotkeys.comment.to: Toggles the material HUD on and off.
